item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: One American's detention in Lebanon exposed a truth that is now devastating an entire country
item.summary: Hezbollah's unchecked power, backed by Iran, enabled Amer Fakhoury's detention and now fuels a devastating war in Lebanon its people never chose.

item.title: NBA faces pressure to alter 65-game eligibility rule for players to be considered for awards
item.summary: The National Basketball Players Association called on the league to amend its 65-game eligibility rule for its stars to be considered for top awards.

item.title: Top Republican in North Carolina Senate concedes race decided by 23 votes
item.summary: North Carolina Republican Senate leader Phil Berger, endorsed by President Donald Trump, conceded the GOP primary race to Sheriff Sam Page after a second recount.

item.title: Trump urges RNC chair's wife to run for Congress, pledges endorsement: 'RUN, SYDNEY, RUN!'
item.summary: President Donald Trump encouraged Sydney Gruters, wife of Republican National Committee Chair Joe Gruters, to run in Florida's 16th Congressional District, pledging to back her if she runs.

item.title: Chicago killing reignites sanctuary city fight as Angel parent heads to Senate hearing
item.summary: The hearing on sanctuary city policies, which will be led by Sen. Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., comes after the death of Sheridan Gorman, who was allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant.

item.title: Shanghai sabotage: Inside Singham's secret strategy to demonize America
item.summary: Fox News Digital reveals how Neville Roy Singham’s network funds and amplifies pro-China messaging through media outlets, activist content and global propaganda operations tied to Cuba and beyond.

item.title: Cannabis may backfire for mental health disorders, major study finds
item.summary: Medicinal cannabinoids show little strong evidence of helping mental health or substance use disorders, University of Sydney researchers concluded in a major review.

item.title: Cowboys star Dak Prescott's ex posts about 'growth' days after couple split before wedding
item.summary: Dallas Cowboys star Dak Prescott's former fiancée, Sarah Jane Ramos, posted about "growth" days after the couple's relationship ended with the wedding around the corner.

item.title: Fox Nation, Tunnels to Towers explores how America’s pastime helped a grieving New York heal after 9/11
item.summary: The New York Mets and Yankees reflect on baseball's role in healing America after 9/11 in a new Tunnels to Towers documentary on Fox Nation.
